name: netted_leaves
description: netted leaves: lit leaf and chevron shapes outlined dark at every escape step, olive, gold and rust, under a fishnet mesh of field lines crossed by level lines that tightens towards the set
notes: Round one (094): triage group (15), texture and lace, the last of round 2. zulu-25 (lit leaf and chevron shapes, dark-outlined, under a fishnet mesh, olive, gold and rust) is the default. The group's other three references are palette entries of existing modes: wallhaven-xld8rd as feather_plumes' copper_feathers (crescent_lines drew it too, for comparison), web_burst as smooth_bands' starburst_lace, within-25 as hollow_webs' knit_webs.

Nearest mode: lit_petals (smoothly lit petals, colours cycling round each). What differs is the net: a `sheet` on the `lines` channel (field lines, radius 2, `divide` 1) cut every 1/32 of a turn, crossed by a `sheet` on the smooth count cut every quarter step, both thin rims multiplied dark, so the leaves are covered in a conformal mesh whose cells shrink towards the set as the lace does. With `divide` 2 (clockwork_rings') the divided angle spans too little of a turn for a 1/32 cut, and no field lines showed. A third `sheet` on the smooth count at period 1 draws each leaf's dark outline; lit_petals' two lights (period 3 slope, period 1 near the set) shade the leaves.
Reachable by one escape loop: no, two. The leaves, outlines and level-line half of the net are the frame's loop; the field lines are the `lines` trap's loop.

Round one's readings: nl_base, nl_fine (twice the lines each way), nl_gilt (the net screened bright gold rather than multiplied dark), nl_bold (wider outlines, glossier light) and nl_nomesh (the headline removed). Seats: a gallery scout (seed 94), twelve kept by eye. Screened at 0.35 the net vanished on the pale leaves; multiplied dark at 0.55 it reads at draft size. In the far field, where the field lines are few, the net opens into large square cells.

Tone: 13 of 14 hold zulu-25's balance (median 0.278 to 0.285 against 0.279, p10 0.089 to 0.111 against 0.085) at both formulation seats and twelve location seats as shipped; nl_loc_11 (phoenix-classic) misses p90 (0.669 against 0.541).

Explorer cost (094, `style cost --location`, no held box: an upper bound): 43.3 s as WebAssembly on one thread at 1280x800 ss2 at the deeper formulation seat (julia-multibrot3_2e04e5e2, maxiter 10,220), under the 5-minute bar.
